what: PreCompact feature request should include detailed implementation attempts: exit 0 + decision:block (proceeds immediately), exit 2 + decision:block (hard error, no agentic turn), exit 0 + systemMessage (shown to user, unclear if agent sees), hookSpecificOutput (validation error — only valid for PreToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/PostToolUse), suppressOutput (doesn't work for Stop/PreCompact), v2.1.105 only added cancel capability.
